title: Request new software through the proper process
symptom: A user wants a new program installed
user_description: I found a great PDF editing tool online. Can you just install it on my laptop today? I don't have time to wait.

options.text: Install it from the website right now
options.why: Skips licensing and security checks. Unapproved software can carry malware or break licence terms.

options.text: Give him admin rights so he can install what he wants
options.why: Gives one person power to install anything on a company PC, which is a serious security risk.

options.text: Say no and close the ticket
options.why: Unhelpful. A good technician shows the user the proper way to get what they need.

options.text: Explain the software request process, such as manager approval and a licence and security check, and help him submit it
options.why: Software needs approval, a valid licence and a security check. Guiding the user through the process keeps the company safe and still gets them what they need.

hints: Who decides which software the company uses?
What checks should happen before new software is installed?
real_world_tip: Ask what he needs the tool to do. The company may already have an approved tool that does the same job.
